notes.title: 0921 Small updates + bug patches
notes.content:
1. A bug that can't click seeds even after watering them in the cafe has been fixed  

2. Simplified/traditional Chinese translation has been updated. (This was the request of the translator.) 

3. Polish translation has been added. 

4. I chose to cut my tongue, but I solved a bug where the saved Mabel character appeared at the same time and I couldn't proceed with the tongue cutting option 

5.The storage has been reduced from 3.6GB to 2.0GB by organizing unnecessary files for the game



Bug reports are always welcome.

Bug report: 

Discord: dead_meat793

Email: panhwa1004@naver.com





+I'm currently fixing a bug that can't press exit right in the first prologue. 

+Translation support is always welcome.

notes.title: 0915 Patch: Update for 16:10 resolution users!
notes.content:
I've corrected the overlapping of the item window and the arrow to the right. Now that I've pulled the arrow a little more inside the screen, it won't overlap anymore. It can now proceed normally.



16:9 resolution users may find it a little awkward to have arrows gathered in the middle, but please still play it as it is. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8474bb4fc47f40b0d36eeface4ed69e17d9da3fa.png"]



If the update doesn't apply, please log out the steam and log in and update it. 

Thank you!

notes.title: purgatory's flower Demo is on the June Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Demo of purgatory's flower is out ! and we are participating in the June Steam Next Fest 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8974f9513ccb118a6b09994f3323b64bec334cd2.png"]
If you have time, please listen to the characters' stories for a moment.Purgatory flowers will be released in September.
This game deals with the miserable, tragic, and beautiful memories of two women, and the pain and healing that have occurred from them. 


[previewyoutube="_Yws7WmKNG0;full"][/previewyoutube]
The amount of the demo is 1/5 of the total, and the playtime is about 30 minutes. 

several endings are waiting for you.



Demo game only supports English and Korean, but in the main game, English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, and Turkish are waiting. 

Also, translation volunteering is always welcome!

(The countries above already have translators.)



Please enjoy the stories of prisoners struggling to escape from purgatory!
